system.description:
ESHARI

Your spirit has stood too long at the threshold to be easily pushed across it.
The racial bonus granted by Soul Warden increases from +1 to +2.
Furthermore, whenever you successfully resist possession, you immediately recognise that something attempted to possess you and know its general direction if its source is within 60 feet.

Prerequisites Level 5

Works automatically: Soul Warden's racial bonus is +2 — this feat adds the second +1 beside it, pre-ticked on the same saves; recognising a possession attempt is a note.

conditionals.label: Soul-Hardened
conditionals.scope: Saving throws against Soul-trait effects, Soul Drain and possession (the second point of Soul Warden's bonus)
